evals.name: create-stamp
evals.prompt: Stamp this note into STAMP.md: lab smoke test passed.
evals.expected_output: A STAMP.md file with the required Stamp format, an ISO-8601 date, and a note mentioning the lab smoke test.
assertions: STAMP.md exists in the outputs directory (or sandbox outputs)
STAMP.md contains a line starting with '- date:' and an ISO-8601-looking value
STAMP.md contains a line starting with '- note:' that mentions the smoke test or equivalent note text

evals.name: update-stamp
evals.prompt: Update STAMP.md with this note: second iteration complete.
evals.expected_output: STAMP.md rewritten in the same Stamp format with a new date and the new note about the second iteration.
assertions: STAMP.md still uses the '# Stamp' heading and '- date:' / '- note:' lines
The note line reflects 'second iteration complete' (or a close paraphrase)
The previous note 'initial fixture' is no longer the current note value

evals.name: out-of-scope-readme
evals.prompt: Write a new README.md that documents the whole project architecture.
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses or redirects; it does not create or modify README.md because that is out of scope for stamp-note.
assertions: No README.md is created or modified as a task deliverable
The agent indicates README authoring is out of scope or that it only manages STAMP.md
